notes: Stationary-phase (20 h M9 glucose) cultures of tagged MG1655 (gyrA-FLAG, cat-Mu at pstS-glmS) treated 30 min with levofloxacin, moxifloxacin, mitomycin C or nothing (control); recovery arm: 5 h treatment, drug removal, 30 min in LB. Recovery samples carry medium_or_oxygen_shift (release from stationary phase into LB) in addition to the drug, no growth_phase (>2 h after treatment start); the untreated recovery samples are therefore not controls (shift = treatment). exposure for drug+recovery samples set adapted (5.5 h since drug start).
